inspection_note: Root alone inspected whole then both supplied halves before reading witnesses; all agreed words/signs and all differences checked in ink. All 82 recorded crops actually viewed, including individual repeats of truncated batches. Slanted top/long notes rotated upright. All eleven C doubt loci decided or explicitly retained; glyphs, indices, hand arrows, deletions and insertion guides checked. Dense overlapping corrections retain localized uncertainty. Reinspection identifies the long parallel mu strokes as its looped stem, without a separate alphabet claim. The crowded ce remains two readable letters; ordinary capitals and H-bullet forms have no positive repeated-strike evidence. Archive pencil 123 retained as a comment under PROMPT rule 4. No context, second-pass audit, or mathematical check has been undertaken. Final dash enlargement confirmed the short mark. A first motifs-m crop clipped the left edge and was replaced by motifs-m-full; both recipes remain documented. The expanded view shows one m body with a weak right-side trace, insufficient positive evidence for a repeated-strike alphabet.
